cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(am_description NONE)

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)

# urdf/am_units.urdf.xacro is generated by tools/gen_ros2_xacro.py from the am-sdk unit data.
install(DIRECTORY urdf DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})

ament_package()
